audience: consultants and sales teams that take meeting bookings through Cal.com event types

useCases.title: Review upcoming bookings
useCases.text: List the bookings, filtered by status or attendee email. Open one booking to read its time, attendees and meeting link.

useCases.title: Find open times for a call
useCases.text: Read the available start times of an event type for a time window. Read the busy times of the connected calendars to see when the account is busy.

useCases.title: Check event types and availability
useCases.text: List the event types and team event types, with their lengths and booking links. Read the weekly hours of one availability schedule.

useCases.title: Book a meeting for an attendee
useCases.text: Book one open slot of an event type for an attendee. This creates a real meeting and emails a confirmation to the attendee.

useCases.title: Cancel a booking
useCases.text: Cancel one booking by its uid. The attendee is notified by email, and this server cannot restore the booking.
